args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 - Summary
args.body:
• Temperature excursions fell 30% among carriers sharing live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: pilots using this approach cut claims by about a quarter.

Sources:
- https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain
- https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion
